result.question: How has Nvidia's net income evolved over its last three fiscal years?
result.answer: Nvidia's net income has grown dramatically over its last three fiscal years. In FY 2024 (period ending January 28, 2024), net income was $29,760,000,000 (approximately $29.8 billion) [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2024-01-28]. In FY 2025 (period ending January 26, 2025), net income rose to $72,880,000,000 (approximately $72.9 billion) [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2025-01-26]. In FY 2026 (period ending January 25, 2026), net income reached $120,067,000,000 (approximately $120.1 billion) [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2026-01-25]. This represents a roughly 145% increase from FY 2024 to FY 2025, and a further approximately 65% increase from FY 2025 to FY 2026, reflecting Nvidia's explosive growth driven by demand for AI-related products.
